newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya opposition takes budget to court.
newsitem.headline: Kenya opposition takes budget to court.

text.p: Kenya's High Court is set to rule on Friday on a petition by seven opposition MPs that the 1997/98 budget cannot be debated in parliament, the Daily Nation newspaper reported on Wednesday.

Opposition members walked out of the National Assembly on Tuesday in support of the suit which argues that Finance Minister Musalia Mudavadi failed to read the budget last week and Speaker Francis ole Kaparo failed to ensure quiet in the chamber.
The opposition disrupted the June 19 speech by shouting and stamping and the session ended in chaos with a punch-up inside the chamber in front of President Daniel arap Moi.
The unprecedented protest was staged to press demands for sweeping constitutional reforms ahead of presidential and parliamentary elections which Moi must call this year.
